title: Software Engineer
description: Designs, builds, and maintains software applications and systems.

steps: Build a strong foundation in math and logical reasoning
Learn a programming language (Python or Java) in school years
Build small personal projects and enter coding competitions
Pursue a B.Tech/B.Sc in CS or a related field
roadmap.workEnvironment: Mostly indoor, computer-based work — solo coding blocks balanced with team stand-ups, code reviews and planning meetings.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (PCM) for most engineering entrances
startNow: Learn Python or Java through a free online course
Build a small personal project — an app, game, or website
Enter a school or online coding competition
Explore an open-source project on GitHub
roadmap.stage1: Build number sense and logical reasoning through math and puzzle-solving.
roadmap.stage2: Choose Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (PCM) or a Computer Science stream in Grades 11-12.
roadmap.stage5: Build two or three small personal projects and contribute to an open-source repository.
roadmap.stage6: Enter as a junior developer or software engineering trainee, then specialize by domain.

title: Doctor (Physician)
description: Diagnoses and treats illness, and helps patients manage their health.

steps: Take Physics, Chemistry, Biology in grades 11-12
Prepare rigorously for NEET
Complete MBBS followed by internship
Choose a specialization based on interest
roadmap.workEnvironment: Hospitals, clinics or labs — long, sometimes irregular hours, with direct patient interaction and a mix of solo diagnosis and team-based care.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB); a qualifying NEET-UG score
startNow: Volunteer at a local health camp or clinic if possible
Read introductory biology or medicine books and documentaries
Join a school science or biology club
Practice NEET-style questions to build exam familiarity early
roadmap.stage1: Build a strong foundation in biology and chemistry fundamentals.
roadmap.stage2: Choose Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) in Grades 11-12.
roadmap.stage5: Shadow a health camp or volunteering opportunity to see patient care first-hand.
roadmap.stage6: Complete MBBS and internship, then choose a specialization based on interest.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Creates visual concepts for branding, digital media, and print.

steps: Build a habit of sketching, photography, or digital art
Learn design tools (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma)
Build a portfolio of original design work
Apply to design entrance exams or a B.Des program
roadmap.workEnvironment: Studio, agency or freelance/remote setup — project-based work with client feedback cycles and creative deadlines.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream; a strong portfolio often matters more than the stream
startNow: Start a sketchbook or digital art habit
Learn a free design tool like Figma or Canva
Build a small portfolio of five or six original pieces
Enter a school or online design competition
roadmap.stage1: Build a consistent sketching, photography or digital-art habit.
roadmap.stage2: Any stream works — focus extracurricular time on building a design portfolio.
roadmap.stage5: Design a personal brand, poster series, or small client project for the portfolio.
roadmap.stage6: Enter as a junior designer, then specialize — brand, UI/UX, motion, or illustration.

title: Teacher / Educator
description: Educates and mentors students, shaping how they learn and grow.

steps: Choose a strong subject specialization in school/college
Gain experience tutoring or mentoring peers
Pursue a B.Ed or integrated teacher-education program
Clear teaching eligibility exams (CTET/State TET)
roadmap.workEnvironment: Classroom-based, with lesson planning outside class hours — high interaction with students, parents and colleagues.
roadmap.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in the subject taught, plus a B.Ed for most school teaching roles
startNow: Tutor a younger student or peer informally
Volunteer as a teaching assistant in a school activity
Practice explaining a topic you know well to someone else
Join a debate or public-speaking club
roadmap.stage1: Pick a subject you enjoy deeply enough to want to explain it to others.
roadmap.stage2: Choose the stream matching your subject of interest.
roadmap.stage5: Get informal tutoring or teaching-assistant experience with younger students.
roadmap.stage6: Complete a B.Ed, start in a school role, and grow into a senior or coordinator position.

title: Entrepreneur / Business Owner
description: Starts and runs a business, taking on risk to bring an idea to market.

exams: CAT / CUET (if pursuing a business degree)
No mandatory exam for direct entrepreneurship
steps: Start small: sell something, run a school/community project
Learn basics of finance, marketing, and negotiation
Consider a BBA/B.Com or a relevant specialization
Seek internships or incubator programs in the interest area
roadmap.workEnvironment: Highly variable — home, co-working spaces or wherever the business needs; long, irregular hours especially early on.
roadmap.eligibility: No fixed eligibility; a business degree or incubator program helps but isn't mandatory
startNow: Start a small venture — sell something, or run a school event or club
Learn basic budgeting and financial literacy
Read about founders or businesses you admire
Seek a mentor or internship at a small business
roadmap.stage1: Practice spotting problems worth solving in everyday school or community life.
roadmap.stage2: Commerce or any stream works — pair it with real small-scale ventures.
roadmap.stage5: Run a small, real project — a school store, an online shop, a service — end to end.
roadmap.stage6: Seek an incubator, mentorship program, or co-founder network to build the first real venture.

title: Chartered Accountant
description: Manages financial records, audits, taxation, and compliance for individuals or businesses.

collegesOrPaths: Direct via ICAI route after Class 12
steps: Take Commerce with Math/Accounts in grades 11-12
Register for CA Foundation after Class 12
Clear CA Intermediate and complete articleship
Clear CA Final to qualify as a Chartered Accountant
roadmap.workEnvironment: Office-based — audit season brings longer hours; steady, structured work the rest of the year.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 (any stream, Commerce preferred); CA Foundation registration after Class 12
startNow: Learn basic bookkeeping or accounting concepts online
Practice real-world budgeting — a family or club budget
Read about how businesses manage their finances
Look into ICAI's CA Foundation route early
roadmap.stage1: Build strong numerical accuracy and comfort with structured, rule-based work.
roadmap.stage2: Choose Commerce with Mathematics/Accounts in Grades 11-12.
roadmap.stage5: Practice with real bookkeeping exercises or a school finance-related project.
roadmap.stage6: Complete CA Intermediate, articleship and CA Final, then qualify as a Chartered Accountant.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Designs, builds, and tests mechanical systems and machinery.

steps: Build interest through hands-on kits, model assembly, or workshops
Strengthen physics and applied math fundamentals
Pursue B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
Specialize via internships (automotive, manufacturing, robotics)
roadmap.workEnvironment: Workshops, factories, and design offices — a mix of hands-on work and computer-based design and testing.
startNow: Build or repair something mechanical — bikes, small machines, kits
Try a beginner CAD tool like Tinkercad or Fusion 360
Join a robotics or engineering club
Enter a school science or engineering fair
roadmap.stage1: Build hands-on experience through kits, model assembly, or basic repairs.
roadmap.stage2: Choose Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (PCM) in Grades 11-12.
roadmap.stage5: Try a beginner CAD project alongside a small hands-on build.
roadmap.stage6: Pursue internships in automotive, manufacturing or robotics to specialize.

title: Psychologist / Counselor
description: Studies human behavior and helps people navigate emotional and mental health challenges.

steps: Take an interest in human behavior, social issues, and listening to others
Pursue BA/BSc in Psychology
Specialize with a master's degree (clinical, counseling, or organizational)
Gain supervised practical/internship experience
roadmap.workEnvironment: Clinics, schools, or private practice — mostly one-on-one or small-group sessions, with case documentation between sessions.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream (Science/Humanities common); BA/BSc Psychology entry requirements vary by college
startNow: Read introductory psychology books or credible articles
Practice active listening in everyday conversations
Volunteer with a peer-support or mental-health awareness initiative
Join a psychology or debate club
roadmap.stage1: Build genuine interest in how people think, feel and behave.
roadmap.stage2: Science or Humanities both work — Psychology as a subject helps if available.
roadmap.stage5: Seek a supervised volunteering or shadowing opportunity in a counselling setting.
roadmap.stage6: Complete a master's degree — clinical, counselling or organizational — with supervised practice.

title: Civil Services Officer (IAS/IPS etc.)
description: Administers government policy and public services at various levels.

steps: Complete a bachelor's degree in any discipline
Build strong general awareness, current affairs, and writing skills
Prepare systematically for UPSC Prelims, Mains, and Interview
Consider state PSC exams as an additional/alternate path
roadmap.workEnvironment: Government offices and field postings — a mix of administrative work, public interaction, and policy implementation.
roadmap.eligibility: Any bachelor's degree; a qualifying score in the UPSC Civil Services Examination or a State PSC exam
startNow: Follow current affairs and news regularly
Practice essay writing on public-interest topics
Join a debate or Model UN club
Read about how government administration works
roadmap.stage1: Build broad general awareness and strong reading and writing habits.
roadmap.stage2: Any stream works — Humanities gives a natural head start for the syllabus.
roadmap.stage5: Practice structured essay writing and current-affairs analysis regularly.
roadmap.stage6: Clear the UPSC or State PSC exams, then build seniority through postings.

title: Content Creator / Filmmaker
description: Produces videos, films, or digital content for an audience across platforms.

steps: Start creating short videos, photography, or writing consistently
Learn editing tools and basic storytelling techniques
Build an audience or portfolio online
Consider formal training (film school/mass comm) if pursuing it professionally
roadmap.workEnvironment: Highly flexible — home studio, on location, or remote; deadline-driven with direct audience feedback.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream; a portfolio or audience often matters more than formal qualification
startNow: Start a small, consistent content series — video, blog, or photography
Learn a free editing tool like CapCut or DaVinci Resolve
Study creators you admire and analyse what works
Enter a school or online content/film competition
roadmap.stage1: Build a habit of creating and sharing content consistently, even in a small way.
roadmap.stage2: Any stream works — use free time to build a portfolio or channel.
roadmap.stage5: Publish a small, consistent body of work and track what resonates with an audience.
roadmap.stage6: Consider formal training in film or mass communication, or keep building an independent portfolio.

title: Data Scientist / AI-ML Engineer
description: Analyzes data and builds models to uncover patterns and drive decisions.

steps: Build strong math, statistics, and logical reasoning skills
Learn Python and basic data analysis tools early
Work on small data/AI projects or competitions
Pursue a relevant B.Tech/B.Sc and specialize via electives or certifications
roadmap.workEnvironment: Computer-based, often remote-friendly — analysis work balanced with presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (PCM) for the B.Tech route
startNow: Learn Python and basic statistics through a free course
Explore a beginner dataset on Kaggle
Build a simple data-visualization project
Enter a school or online data/AI challenge
roadmap.stage1: Build strong math, statistics and logical-reasoning fundamentals.
roadmap.stage2: Choose Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics (PCM), ideally with Computer Science.
roadmap.stage5: Work through a beginner data project or online competition.
roadmap.stage6: Specialize via electives, certifications or an internship in data and AI.

title: HR / People Operations Manager
description: Manages recruitment, employee relations, and workplace culture within organizations.

steps: Build interpersonal and communication skills through group activities/leadership roles
Pursue a BBA/BMS or related bachelor's degree
Gain internship experience in HR or people-facing roles
Consider an MBA specializing in HR for advancement
roadmap.workEnvironment: Office-based — a mix of one-on-one conversations, meetings, and policy or documentation work.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream; a BBA/BMS or related bachelor's degree
startNow: Take on a coordination role in a school club or event
Practice mediating small disagreements among peers
Read about workplace culture and people management
Join a leadership or student council initiative
roadmap.stage1: Build comfort with group coordination and interpersonal communication.
roadmap.stage2: Any stream works — Commerce/Humanities give a natural head start.
roadmap.stage5: Take on an organizing or coordination role in a school or community group.
roadmap.stage6: Gain internship experience in an HR or people-facing role, then consider an MBA in HR.

title: Architect
description: Designs buildings and spaces, balancing aesthetics, function, and structure.

steps: Build skills in drawing, spatial reasoning, and design software basics
Take Math in grades 11-12 (required for architecture entrance)
Prepare for NATA/JEE Paper 2
Pursue a 5-year B.Arch program
roadmap.workEnvironment: Studio-based design work combined with site visits — collaborative, with engineers, contractors and clients.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 with Mathematics; a qualifying NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 score
startNow: Practice freehand sketching and basic technical drawing
Try a beginner CAD tool for simple 3D models
Study buildings and spaces you find interesting and note why
Enter a school design or model-making competition
roadmap.stage1: Build spatial reasoning and drawing skills through sketching and model-making.
roadmap.stage2: Take Mathematics in Grades 11-12 — required for architecture entrances.
roadmap.stage5: Practice a small design project, from sketch to a simple model or CAD drawing.
roadmap.stage6: Pursue a 5-year B.Arch program, then specialize during internships.

title: Sales & Marketing Professional
description: Drives business growth by promoting products/services and building client relationships.

steps: Practice persuasive communication and pitching ideas
Pursue a BBA/B.Com with a marketing focus
Gain internship experience in sales, marketing, or client-facing roles
Consider an MBA in Marketing for leadership roles
roadmap.workEnvironment: Client-facing and target-driven — a mix of meetings, pitching, and campaign planning, often with travel.
roadmap.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream; a BBA/B.Com with a marketing focus
startNow: Practice pitching an idea or product to friends or family
Run a small sales or fundraising initiative for a school event
Study ad campaigns you find effective and note why
Join a debate or public-speaking club
roadmap.stage1: Build comfort with persuasive communication and pitching ideas.
roadmap.stage2: Any stream works — Commerce gives a natural head start.
roadmap.stage5: Run a small sales, fundraising or marketing initiative for a school or community event.
roadmap.stage6: Gain internship experience in a client-facing role, then consider an MBA in Marketing.
